_readme: Copy this file to oauth_client.json and fill in the ids you created.
It lets one person do the developer-console setup once and everyone else
just press Connect and sign in as themselves. Put it either here or in
the OS config folder (%APPDATA%/nightjar on Windows, ~/.config/nightjar
elsewhere); the config folder wins if both exist.
This file holds a credential and is gitignored. Never commit it.
Gmail: create the client in Google Cloud Console, add the redirect URI
http://localhost:8766/callback, and add each person's Google address
under Audience -> Test users. Up to 100 people.
Note: while the app stays in Testing, Google expires each sign-in after
7 days, so everyone re-signs in about weekly - one click on the card.
Publishing removes that, but Gmail read access is a restricted scope and
cannot be published without a paid annual security assessment.
Slack: create an app at api.slack.com/apps, add the same redirect URL,
then copy the id and secret from Basic Information.
